name: readme-kit
description: Compile intent (theme + pack + YAML/JSON) into GitHub-safe README branding

scripts.test: node bin/readme-kit.mjs build examples/luffy/readme.config.yaml -o /tmp/luffy-readme-yaml.md && node bin/readme-kit.mjs build examples/luffy/readme.config.json -o /tmp/luffy-readme-json.md && cmp -s /tmp/luffy-readme-yaml.md /tmp/luffy-readme-json.md && test -s /tmp/luffy-readme-yaml.md
